ItemId.description: The platform's 26-character id; omit it to create a new one.

Name.description: The business whose AI agents buy from the store.

TestMode.description: Whether its agents may only pay with test credentials.

OAuthClientId.description: The client ID of its OAuth client on the store's OpenID server.

ProfileUrl.description: The address of its UCP profile, whose keys verify its signed requests.

WebhookUrl.description: Where its ACP order updates go.

AllowedPaymentHandlers.description: The payment handlers its agents may pay through; empty allows all.

AllowedIpRanges.description: The IP addresses and CIDR ranges its requests come from; empty allows any.

EmbeddedCheckoutOrigins.description: The https origins whose pages may show the store's checkout in a frame (UCP embedded checkout).

AcpOrderCreatedEvent.description: The ACP event name a new order sends; order_create when empty.

AcpOrderUpdatedEvent.description: The ACP event name a changed order sends; order_update when empty.

AcpRequireSignedRequests.description: Whether its ACP requests must carry a valid Signature and Timestamp.

AcpSignatureAlgorithm.description: The algorithm its ACP requests are signed with; ES256 when empty.

AcpSignaturePublicKey.description: The P-256 public key that verifies its signed ACP requests: an EC JSON Web Key or a PEM PUBLIC KEY block.

AcpSignatureClockSkewSeconds.description: How many seconds a signed request's Timestamp may be from the store's clock; 300 when empty.

Platforms.description: The AI agent platforms to create or update. API keys and webhook secrets are never imported; give them new ones in the admin.
